component.name: Proton Drive Setup
component.summary: Sign in and configure the Proton Drive sync daemon

description.p: Graphical wizard that signs you in to Proton Drive and lets you choose how the background sync daemon stores your session (plain file vs. GPG-encrypted via pass). Also installs the official Proton Drive CLI itself if it's missing, and offers to apply CLI updates the sync daemon detects.
Launched automatically by kio-protondrive-sync-daemon when it needs authentication or a confirmed CLI update, or runnable manually.
